description: Implementation of WindowInfosListenerInvoker class managing window info listeners, handling registration, deregistration, death, updates, and acknowledgments within Android's SurfaceFlinger service.

classes.name: WindowInfosListenerInvoker
classes.description: Invoker class managing window info listeners, handling registration, deregistration, death, updates, and acknowledgments.

methods.name: addWindowInfosListener
methods.description: Registers a new window info listener and associates it with a listener ID.

methods.name: removeWindowInfosListener
methods.description: Removes a registered window info listener.

methods.name: binderDied
methods.description: Handles the death of a binder, cleaning up associated listeners and notifying relevant parties.

methods.name: windowInfosChanged
methods.description: Handles window info updates, manages delayed updates, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: getDebugInfo
methods.description: Retrieves debug information about the invoker's current state.

methods.name: updateMaxSendDelay
methods.description: Updates the maximum send delay metric based on current delay.

methods.name: ackWindowInfosReceived
methods.description: Acknowledges receipt of window info updates for a specific vsync ID and listener ID.
